# Sunset to Aurora Dissolve

## About

Two scenes butt against each other at 5 s on Video 1, and a Cross Dissolve 36 frames long sits
centred on the cut, so it starts at 4.25 s and ends at 5.75 s. The aurora clip starts two seconds
into its media, which gives the dissolve the head handle it needs. The thumbnail is the middle of
the dissolve: the sun and its reflection are still visible through the first ribbons of the aurora.
